name: publicWeb_searchKennels
description: Kennel directory search for the web's Kennels tab (E9.F7.S9): matches kennel name, short name, slug, city, region, country AND the four *SearchTags columns (commas read as spaces), because 'Scotland' is neither a Region nor a Country row. Eligibility is the app's browse rule: not deleted/removed and KennelStatus NOT IN (-1 Defunct, 4 Inactive-Hidden) — Active 2, Inactive-Visible 1 and Mismanagement Only 0 are listed (DomainValues.KennelStatusEnum). Empty query returns every eligible kennel by name. Public read; no auth.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The words typed, matched as one LIKE '%q%' substring (trimmed). NULL/empty returns every eligible kennel.

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: Eligible matching kennels, ordered by KennelName.

columns.name: LastRunGmt
columns.description: MAX(Event.EventStartDateTimeGmt) over the kennel's visible, live runs; NULL when it has none

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
